svg.title: iPawcus — System Class Diagram
svg.desc: Domain UML class diagram: names, typed attributes, operations, and relationships. Every label is above its own relationship line near the class. Lines avoid all class boxes. Supporting pages include the complete domain model.
svg.text: Classes show attributes and operations. Solid: association · dashed: logical association · dashed arrow: dependency.
Core system objects; all classes and attributes are included on the complete-model and detail sheets.
